items.html: And the worlds rose in this manner: ZA rose to the place that is now the place of Arich Anpin, and the Nukva of ZA rose to the place that is now the place of Aba, and Beria rose to the place that is now the place of Ima, and Yetzira to the place of ZA, and Assiya to the place of Malchut, the Nukva of ZA.
